raw_segments.text: All this time, Dr. Herzenstube, who was called in by Katarina Ivanovna, came punctually every
other day, but little was gained by his visits and he dosed the invalid mercilessly.
But on that Sunday morning, a new doctor was expected, who had come from Moscow, where
Katarina Ivanovna had sent for him from Moscow at great expense, not expressly for Alusha,
but for another object of which more will be said in its place hereafter.

He hadn't the slightest idea that Kalya Krasetkin was coming, though he had long wished for
a visit from the boy for whom Alusha was fretting.
